title: KEN GRIFFEY JR. - 1990 Bowman #481 - Seattle Mariners Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1990 Bowman #481 Ken Griffey Jr. baseball card featuring the Seattle Mariners player in the Major League (MLB). This original card is made of card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. and is part of the 1990 Bowman set. The card is valued for its historical significance and popularity among sports trading card enthusiasts, particularly those interested in collecting MLB memorabilia from the 1990s. It is a sought-after item for fans of Griffey Jr. and the Seattle Mariners.
